title: Kinsta Review 2026: Pricing, Speed Tests, Support and Black Friday Offer
excerpt: Kinsta starts at $35 a month and tops many speed tests. Here is what you pay, what the Black Friday offer is worth, and who should skip it.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Kinsta Review 2026: Pricing, Speed Tests, Support
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Kinsta review for 2026: plan prices, what the Black Friday offer is really worth, speed and uptime from three independent tests, support, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Kinsta is premium managed WordPress hosting with top-tier speed and human support. It starts at $35 a month, and the Black Friday offer saves 12.5% to 25% over the first year.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Kinsta good? | Yes for sites where speed and support matter. Webhostingcat measured a 100% GTmetrix score, and WP Umbrella recorded 100% uptime on its monitored sites.
Is Kinsta worth the money? | It is worth it for agencies, WooCommerce stores and busy sites. WP Umbrella says it is not the right fit for small sites with little traffic.
How much does Kinsta cost? | Single-site plans run from $35 to $375 a month at list price. Agency plans have their own price list, and Enterprise starts at $500.
What is the Kinsta Black Friday offer? | 50% off for 3 months on monthly plans, 3 months off on annual plans, and the first month free on select plans, for new customers. It ends on 1 December 2026.
Does Kinsta have phone support? | No. Support is 24/7 through chat and tickets, with human help in 8 languages listed.
Is Kinsta good for WooCommerce? | Yes. WP Umbrella hosts WooCommerce stores on it, and Webhostingcat's load test finished 1,000 requests with no timeouts.
Does Kinsta offer free migrations? | Yes. Kinsta lists free site migrations, and WP Umbrella says the team moved sites from other hosts without help.
Does Kinsta include email or domains? | No. Kinsta does one thing: managed WordPress and WooCommerce hosting.
Does Kinsta have AI features? | We found no built-in AI assistant. It has an API and tutorials for building your own MCP server.
Is Kinsta better than Cloudways? | Kinsta is fully managed and costs more. Cloudways costs less and gives more control. Hostingstep measured similar response times for the two.
Does Kinsta have a money-back guarantee? | Yes. Kinsta lists a 30-day money-back guarantee.
Who should avoid Kinsta? | Owners of small, low-traffic sites on a tight budget, and anyone who wants phone support or email in the same account.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Webhostingcat measured a 100% GTmetrix score and 77 ms time to first byte.
WP Umbrella recorded 100% uptime on 20 monitored sites.
Plans start at $35 a month, and there is no phone support.
The Black Friday offer saves 12.5% to 25% over the first year, depending on the plan and billing.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Kinsta is one of the strongest managed WordPress hosts for sites that earn money. Three independent sources found it fast and reliable, and support gets praise. The price floor is high, and there is no phone line.
meta.rl_r_buy:
Your site earns money and speed and support matter more than price.
You manage many client sites as an agency.
You want daily backups, staging and a CDN included.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You run a small blog on a tight budget.
You want phone support.
You want domains and email in the same account.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Top-tier speed in independent tests.
100% uptime on 20 monitored sites.
Human support with replies in minutes.
Daily backups, staging, CDN and free migrations included.
A 30-day money-back guarantee.
meta.rl_r_cons:
The price floor is $35 a month.
No phone support.
Strict visit and storage limits on lower plans.
No email, domains or site builder.
No built-in AI features.
meta.rl_r_best: Agencies, WooCommerce stores and busy business sites
